name: Binary Pot
original_name: バイナリィ・ポット -Binary Pot-
source:
A romantic adventure unfolding across the real world and the online realm, centered around connecting to the famous online game "World" and the internet cafe "Binary Pot", known for its delicious coffee and waitresses.
